values.note: Minnesota state forest drive-in campsite, taxes included; Esther Lake began charging in 2026. Paid online on the arrival date or at a state park ranger station; nothing is collected at the campground. DNR state forest fee page, read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('Starting in 2026, all forest campgrounds that previously did not charge a camping fee will charge $17 per night'; affected campgrounds 'Grand Portage State Forest: Devilfish Lake, Esther Lake, McFarland'; 'Fees include taxes'; 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site') + DNR facility cmp00056 (camping fee 1), read 2026-11-11

note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground on Esther Lake in the Arrowhead north of Grand Marais, with a boat ramp, dock and swimming. No garbage service: pack out all trash. Managed by Judge C.R. Magney State Park. --Claude
summary: DNR facility cmp00056 read: 3 primitive sites, accessible vault toilet, boat ramp + dock, no garbage; free -> $17 (DNR lists Esther Lake among the campgrounds that began charging in 2026). Lakefront -> lakeview proposed (sites cannot be placed on open ground at the water). Pin is in the lake; phone and website fixes.
flags: FEES changed 0 -> 17 (derived value from old note prose): the DNR state forest fee page lists Esther Lake among the campgrounds that 'previously did not charge a camping fee' and 'will charge $17 per night' starting 2026; the DNR facility record has camping fee 1.

WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (defaults down; no waterfront_evidence, no --AWH value). On Esri imagery the campground is a short gravel road from the northeast that forks at the DNR point 47.98191,-90.10775: the west branch runs to an open gravel turnaround and the boat ramp/dock at about 47.9813,-90.1085, and the southeast spur ends at about 47.9813,-90.1072 beside the tip of a small bay, about 10-15 m from the water through a fringe of trees and shrubs. The three sites cannot be told apart or numbered on imagery, and no DNR or other photo of a site was found (the DNR banner shows only the shoreline). The open gravel at the ramp is the launch turnaround, not a sold site. Lakefront needs a named site on open ground within ~50 m; not established, so lakeview. Reviewer may restore lakefront if a site photo shows the SE spur pad open to the bay.
PIN 47.98150,-90.10780 is in the water of the small bay, about 15 m offshore. Suggest the DNR facility point 47.98191,-90.10775 (the fork of the campground road), about 45 m away.
